title: Render portfolio evidence links inside the AgentGov site

requirement.summary: Replace raw Markdown and broken out-of-root schema links in the public evidence portfolio with AgentGov-styled HTML reference pages and published, synchronized schema assets.

objective.rationale: GitHub Pages served linked Markdown as raw source and resolved ../schemas outside the project base path, breaking the intended evidence-reading journey.

goal: Make every portfolio evidence link open a readable, branded page within the AgentGov GitHub Pages project while retaining repository Markdown and schemas as the authoritative sources.
non_goals: Do not replace repository Markdown or JSON sources with generated HTML as the contract authority.
Do not introduce a client-side Markdown renderer, external CDN, runtime service, or unsafe HTML injection path.
Do not change governance semantics, schemas, release identity, or consumer repositories.
Do not publish, commit, or push without separate human authorization.
acceptance_signals: No portfolio href ends in .md or starts with ../.
Every portfolio reference target exists inside docs and uses the shared AgentGov reference layout.
Published schema JSON files are byte-identical to their authoritative repository schemas.
Schema labels open styled HTML views and the adjacent JSON assets remain directly addressable.
Reference pages preserve AgentGov navigation, visual tokens, source attribution, and human-authority boundaries.
Focused page tests and the complete unit suite pass.

items: Jekyll include or base-path behavior could produce a local-looking source file that fails after Pages builds.
Published schema copies could drift from their authoritative source files.
A generic Markdown rendering mechanism could create an unsafe or misleading content boundary.

stop_conditions: Stop if the solution requires enabling unsafe client-side rendering or an external runtime dependency.
Stop if schema publication requires changing the authoritative schema content.
Stop if GitHub Pages cannot produce project-base-aware HTML from repository-owned sources.

decision.rationale: The user supplied public screenshots and exact failing URLs showing raw Markdown presentation and two schema 404 responses.
